title: Expose an explicit private low-precision epilogue composition pass

evidence.note: Independent review at cde6f56e: typed and emitted-source CPU composition checks, valid-but-ineligible access probes and 124/124 unchanged Corpus Gate. No device execution.
Released Compiler applies the explicit composition to two real example Schedules; metadata is unbound and no GPU qualification is claimed.

observation: The existing IR expresses the two stages and their fused result. A Compiler-owned explicit pass can remove a private BF16/FP16 store/reload while preserving the authored cast, without importing Lab or OMOE policies. No full program graph is supplied: the caller owns the private-composition and nonaliasing contract.
proposed_change: Provide the bounded explicit pass and retain refusal reasons; do not enable an implicit optimizer or add a general graph/pass registry.
verification_plan: Capability verification remains pending: run new properly admitted campaigns on the successor with a composed Workload, independent oracle, fixed baseline and profiler. CPU/source checks establish implementation behavior only; do not close this capability finding as GPU/performance qualified.
